does: Computes the final value of one roll an interrupt changes: for the roll's Guid takes the event's roll (InterruptEvent variant 2 SpellRoll or 3 ConditionalRoll at +0xA8) and fills RollAdjustments.ResolvedRoll (+0x48): an earlier resolution of the same roll, a FixedAdjustment (SetRoll: the set natural plus BaseAdjustment plus the roll's bonus), UseMaxRoll, BaseAdjustment alone (AdjustRoll), a changed advantage choosing between the two dice already thrown, or RerollConditions rerolled through eoc::roll::stream::RollManager::RerollDice.

evidence.says: the Toolkit's esv::interrupt::ResolveRollAdjustmentsForRoll has the same signature (InterruptEvent, Guid, ResolvedData map, RollManager, RollAdjustments); the only caller of RerollDice

called on the interrupt's use before every adjustment seen (twice per used interrupt: in the cast's update the tick of the roll and again in the pass that applies it); under Lucky it called RerollDice once and the roll became natural 11 from 3 with no new roll event
